title: Peter Lynch
html: Who: Ran Fidelity's Magellan Fund to roughly 29% average annual returns over 13 years. Core ideas: Invest in what you understand; know your story for every holding; far more money is lost preparing for corrections than in corrections. Read: One Up on Wall Street; Beating the Street. For our plan: The checklist item "one sentence on why you own each holding" is pure Lynch. Back to Council of Masters
